title: Tech giants face audits and disclosure under AI safety blueprint
headline: Tech giants face audits and disclosure under AI safety blueprint
summary: An AI committee has proposed broad changes to copyright laws. It has also made sweeping recommendations for what would be world-leading safety regulations.
why_it_matters: Organisations must monitor potential major shifts in copyright law and safety regulations as new world-leading AI frameworks are proposed.
